title.narrative: Knowledge management activities on GHG abatement and low carbon urban development

target.value: Documentation on low carbon city development in Shijiazhuang

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks capacity-building and knowledge management activities focused on GHG abatement and low-carbon urban development. In Year 1 and 2, the annual target is for 200 officials participating in training and knowledge management activities (of which 40 percent female). In Year 3, the program will organize roundtable and/or thematic seminar on low carbon city development. In Year 4, knowledge sharing event on low carbon city development will be organized. In Year 5, the program will culminate in the documentation on low carbon city development in Shijiazhuang.

title.narrative: Buildings data platform and monitoring system for managing and capturing GHG emission sources from the building sector

baseline.value: No data platform for monitoring and reporting for the city's building sector

target.value: MHURCB produces the first annual report including an energy efficiency level analysis of at least six building types

comment.narrative: This indicator tracks and captures monthly data on energy consumption and CO2 emissions from various buildings. It monitors emissions, assesses building energy performance, and supports decision-making by providing insights into trends and areas that require improvement. The platform also facilitates compliance with CO2 reduction targets and reporting requirements, while enabling transparent communication with stakeholders about the city's progress toward low-carbon development in the building sector.

title.narrative: Transit nodes developed/redeveloped according to ToD planning and design concepts (Number of transit nodes)

target.value: 8 transit nodes developed/redeveloped according to ToD planning and design concepts (Cumulative 20 transit nodes developed/ redeveloped according to ToD planning and design concepts)

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the effectiveness of the development or redevelopment of 20 ToD nodes, focusing on enhancing accessibility and multimodality to increase metro ridership. This indicator aims to strengthen Shijiazhuang's capacity to create pedestrian-friendly streets in station catchment areas, seamless transfers between multiple transport modes, and integrate public spaces with green infrastructure. The following criteria will be followed (a) the service area within 500 meters of the station is accessible by a 5-minute bike ride or a 10-minute walk with an accessibility rate of =80 percent; (b) the distance between the metro station entrances/exits and the nearest bus stop is =200 meters; (c) there is ample bicycle parking space around the metro station, and it does not obstruct pedestrian passage; and (d) the station is accessible by multiple mode of transportation, with convenient travel options (considering accessibility for people with disabilities).

title.narrative: Share of women in technical and decision-making positions in the implementing SOEs

comment.narrative: This indicator measures women's representation in technical and decision-making roles. The target is to increase the percentage of women in technical positions at the two implementing companies i.e., SOEs fully owned by Shijiazhuang municipal government (SSCDIG and STIDG) from the current 27.2 percent to 30 percent by Period 2, 32 percent by Period 3, 34 percent by Period 4, and 35 percent by the closing period.

title.narrative: PDO indicator 1- Net GHG emission reductions per year from energy efficient buildings, ToD, and NbS (Metric ton CO2e/year)

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the annualized reduction of GHG emissions under the program, comparing the changes in emissions between a baseline scenario47 and the Program intervention scenario48. Program emissions reductions (scope 1) are estimated for a representative year (2030 for the Program) for investments in which the physical assets financed by the program have been fully implemented and are operating at full capacity49. Net GHG emissions reductions per FY are the sum of net emissions reductions of projects approved in the reported fiscal year50. For intermediary years, annualized emissions for RA1 are averaged on the 5-year duration of the program. Emissions reductions for RA2 are assessed from the energy efficiency improvements per square meter of the different types of buildings constructed under the program and by the energy saving from school retrofits. Emission values are estimated ex-ante and at the program-level using approved GHG accounting methodologies.
